nonBlockingObservations.title: The placement/listing bound must cover passes with zero admitted members
nonBlockingObservations.description: A2-3 now assigns placement and visible-repository listing to the member term. Those operations can occur with zero admitted members, for example a glob-only carrier or entries whose candidates are excluded. The later bound must include these charges at n=0 and account for declaring entries/listed population, rather than multiplying all such work by the admitted-member count. The requirement to assign every charge exactly once already prohibits omission; carry this case into B3-b3a validation.
